listing.description_html:
Enter your post-money SAFEs and the terms of the priced round; see how many shares each SAFE converts into, the round price per share, and who owns what afterwards.

This calculator takes the shares and options you have, each post-money SAFE (amount and valuation cap) and the priced round (pre-money valuation and new money). It shows each SAFE's ownership at conversion, the shares each one receives, the round's price per share, the new investors' shares and everyone's ownership after the round.

What's included

  • Each post-money SAFE's ownership at conversion (amount / valuation cap)
  • Shares issued to every SAFE holder, without circular formulas
  • Priced round: price per share and new investor shares
  • Ownership after the round for founders, option pool, SAFE holders and new investors
  • Founder dilution in percentage points, plus a CHECK flag when SAFEs reach 100%
  • PDF guide with the formulas, a worked example and the limits stated plainly

Who it's for

  • Founders raising or about to convert SAFEs
  • Startup operators preparing for a seed or Series A priced round
  • Angel investors checking what a SAFE converts into
  • Accelerator and incubator teams teaching cap table basics

You get: safe_conversion_dilution_calculator.xlsx (Settings, SAFEs, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a modelling tool, not legal, tax or investment advice. Conversion depends on the exact wording of your SAFE documents and the priced round; confirm every figure with your lawyer before you sign or rely on it.
